title: **Iran Unveils 4 Nuclear Achievements, Enters Fusion System Construction Phase, AEOI Chief Says**
text:
"**Iran Unveils 4 Nuclear Achievements, Enters Fusion System Construction Phase, AEOI Chief Says**"

""
"The head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) announced that Iran is now among the nations possessing a nuclear fusion system, stating that the country has moved past the technology demonstration phase and has entered the stage of system construction and capability development.
